title: Workforce Pell Credential Value Ranker
description: Ranks 21 Workforce Pell-eligible short-term credentials by ROI, wage gain, demand, and Pell coverage — personalized to the user's base Pell eligibility. Embeds BLS OEWS May 2023 wages and BLS OOH 2024-34 projections for healthcare, IT/cyber, skilled trades, manufacturing, transportation, and financial services. AP2 v2.0 mandate type: workforce_pell_credential_rank.
data_vintage: BLS OEWS May 2023; BLS OOH 2024-34; ED Pell Grant 2026-27; OBBBA P.L. 119-21
regulatory_citations: BLS OEWS May 2023 — national occupational wage statistics
ED Dear Colleague Letter 2026-01-30 — 2026-27 Pell max/min amounts
OBBBA P.L. 119-21 (July 4, 2025) — Workforce Pell proration formula

mcp_tool_definition.name: rank_workforce_pell_credentials
mcp_tool_definition.description: Given AGI or SAI, family size, current income, and optional budget, ranks 21 Workforce Pell-eligible credentials by ROI, wage gain, demand, and Pell coverage. Returns top 5 with award amounts, net cost, BLS entry wages, and 10-yr demand. Deterministic.
